translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: IN YANCUIC TLAHTOLI ICA JESUCRISTO QUEN OQUIHCUILUI IN LUCAS

content: In Jesús huan Zaqueo
Oncan in Jesús oahxihuac Jericó huan opanoloc ipan in altepetl.
Huan ompa ocatca se rico itoca Zaqueo, yehhuatl in tlayecanqui den renderos.
In Zaqueo oquinequiyaya teixmatis in Jesús, huan ahhuel oteitac tleca ahmo coutic huan ocatcahque miyac tlacamen.
Oncan otzecuin tlicantiu, huan ic teitas otlehcoc ihtech se cohuitl inahuac canic panolos in Jesús.
Ihcuac opanolohtaya ompa in Jesús, omotac huan omoluic: ―Zaqueo, xitemo ihsiu, tleca axan nimocahuas mochan.
Oncan Zaqueo otemoc ihsiu huan ica paquilistli oteseli in Jesús.
Ic oquitaque inin, opeuque teca tlahtohuahque in Jesús, tleca ohuilohuac ichan in tlahtlacolyo.
Oncan Zaqueo omoquetz huan oteiluic in Totecohtzin: ―Mamocaqui, Notecohtzin. Niyau niquinmaca in prohues tlahcopa in tlen nicpiya. Huan in tla onicuili in aquin onicahcayau, nicuepilis naupa ocachi.
In Jesús omoluic: ―Axan maquistoque inin mochanihcahuan, quen inin tlacatl noyojqui ixuiu in Abraham.
Tleca nehhua aquin Nitetiachicau ica nochin tlacatl onihuala niquintemohua ic niquinmaquixtis in aquin poliutoque.
In tlalnamictilistli ica in mahtlactli tomin

Ic otecacticatcahque in tlacamen in Jesús, omoluihque se tlalnamictilistli, tleca ayacmo huehca den Jerusalén, huan yehhuan oquinehnehuiliyayahque quenin in tetlatequiutilistzin Dios hualahsisquiyani saniman.
Oncan omoluihque: ―Ocatca se tlacatl cuali in ichanihcahuan, huan oya huehca ipan oc sequin altepemen ic quitocahhuisque hueyixtoc. Huan satepa mocuepas.
Achto ic quisas, oquinnotz mahtlactli itlaquehualuan, huan oquinmacti cada seya in tomin, huan oquiniluic: “Xictequitiltican hasta nihualas.”
Huan in tlacamen den ialtepeu oquihtohque: “Ahmo ticnequihque inin tlacatl maye hueyixtos ic techtequiutis.”
Masque oquitocahhuihque hueyixtoc huan omocuep ipan ialtepeu. Ihcuac oahsito, oquinnotz in itlaquehualuan aquin oquinmacac in tomin, ic quimatis quesqui yoquitlan cada seya.
In achto omotemacti huan oquiiluic: “Noteco, ica onictlan mahtlactli tanto ica in motomin.”
In hueyixtoc oquinanquilic: “Molui cuali; tehhuatl se cuali tlaquehuali huan quen titlamelajcan chihton, nimitzcahuilis xiquintequiuti mahtlactli altepemen.”
Omotemacti in oc seya huan oquiluic: “Noteco, yonictlan macuili tanto ica in motomin.”
Noyojqui inin oquinanquilic: “Tehhuatl tiquintequiutis macuili altepemen.”
Oncan omotemacti in oc seya huan oquiluic: “Noteco, nicanca in motomin. Oniqueu ica in payo.
Tleca onimomouti ica tehhua, quen tequin tiyolchicahuac huan ticsentlalis in tlen ahmo tictlalihtoc.”
Oncan in hueyixtoc oquiluic: “Tlaquehuali ahmo cuali, ica motlahtol nimitzixcomacas. Oticmat niyolchicahuac huan nicsentlalis in tlen ahmo nictocatoc.
Tel, ¿tleca ahmo otitetlaneuti in tomin huan nicselini in itlatlan ic onimocuep nochan?”
Huan oquiniluic in aquin ompa ocatcahque: “Xicuilican in tomin huan xicmacacan in aquin quipiya in mahtlactli tanto.”
Yehhuan oquiluihque: “Noteco, yehhuatl yiquipiya in mahtlactli tanto.”
Huan in hueyixtoc oquinnanquilic: “Namechiluiya quen in aquin quipiya, quimacasque ocachi, huan in aquin ahmo quipiya, quicuilisque hasta in chihton tlen quipiya.
Huan noyojqui notecocolihcahuan aquin ahmo oquinejque nechpiyasque quen hueyixtoc, xiquinualicacan nican huan xiquinmictican noixpa.”
In Jesús calacohua ipan in Jerusalén
Satepa ic omihto inin, in Jesús oc sepa omoan in ohtli hasta Jerusalén.
Ihcuac yoahxihuataya ipan in altepemen Betfagé huan Betania, inahuac in tepetl itoca Olivos, omotequiutihque ome tetlamachticahuan.
Huan omoluihque: ―Xiyacan ipan in altepetontli tlachicoyan huan ic nanahsitihue, nancahsisque se burro ilpihtoc, quen niyan aquin ipan motlalihtoc. Xictohtomacan huan xicualicacan.
Huan tla aquin mechtlahtlaniya tleca nanquitohtoma, xiquiluican in Totecohtzin monequi.
In tetlamachticahuan oyahque huan ocahsitohque ijcon quen omononotzque in Jesús.
Huan ihcuac oquitohtonticatcahque in burro, in itecohuan oquiniluihque: ―¿Tleca nanquitohtoma in burro?
Yehhuan oquinnanquilihque: ―Tleca in Totecohtzin monequi.
In Jesús otehualiquilihque in burro, huan oquipehpechtihque huan ipan omotlaliloc in Jesús.
Huan quen ohuilohuaticatca, in tlacamen oquisoutayahque intlaquen ipan in ohtli.
Ic oahsitohque ipan in tlatemoli den Olivos tepetl, nochin tlaneltocanimen opeuque tzahtzihque ica paquilistli huan temahuestiliyahque in Dios ica nochin tlachiuten tlen oquitaque.
Oquihtohque: ―¡Mahuesticatzintli in hueyixtoc aquin huitz ica Itocahtzin Totecohtzin! Yolpaquilistli tehuan Yehhuatzin aquin ilohuac neluicac. ¡Xitemahuestilican Yehhuatzin!
Oncan sequin fariseos ocatcahque inepanco inon tlacamen huan oteiluihque: ―Tlamachtiyani, xiquintlacahualti in aquin mitzcuitlapanuihtinemihque.
Huan Jesús oquinnanquililoc: ―Namechiluiya, in tla inin mocahuasque, in temen tzahtzisque.
Ihcuac ahxihuatiu, ic motas in altepetl Jerusalén, in Jesús ochocohuac ica yehhua.
Huan omihto: ―In tla nanquinehnehuilinihque motonal den temaquixtilistli. Huan axan inon tlatiutoc huan ahhuel nanquitasque.
Huan mechualahsis sequin tonali ahmo cuali, huan in namotecocolihcahuan mechyehualosque huan mechixnamiquisque ic nohuiyan.
Huan mechtlalmotlasque huan mechtlamisque, huan ahmo mechcahuilisque niyan se tetl tecpantos. Tleca ahmo onantechiuque cuenta ihcuac in Dios ohualuilohuaya mechitalo ic mechpalehuilos.
In Jesús oquintotocaloc in tlanemacanimen ipan in hueyi tiopantli
Oncan in Jesús ocalacohuac ipan in tiopantli huan oquintotocaloc caltenco in tlanemacanimen huan in tlacoucamen.
Huan omoluihque: ―Ipan in Tlahcuiloltzin quihtohua: “In nochan yehhua in cali den tlayolmachtilistli”; huan namehhuan nanquichiutoque cali den ichtejcamen.

Mostli in Jesús otlamachtilohuaya ipan in tiopantli, huan in tlayecancamen den tiopixcamen, huan in tlamachtiyanimen den tlanahuatilten, huan noyojqui in tlayecancamen den altepetl oquitemoticatcahque quen cuali temictisque.
Huan ahmo ocahsique quen quichihuasque tleca nochin tlacatl otechiuticatcahque cuenta.
